answer: Locks are entered in pearl, expire in onyx, and wander lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 177 aliases therefore needs 200 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1952 identities would post 4693 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
